hero.lead: Every trip below runs on a set weekly schedule with a small group — reserve your seat and we'll handle the rest.

sections.h2: Small-group Morocco tours for every kind of traveler
sections.lead: Choose a ready-to-book fixed departure or tell us which original route you would like to see next. Every itinerary is designed around shared transport, local guides and time to explore independently.

cards.title: 4-Day Sahara Desert Group Tour
cards.blurb: Ait Benhaddou, the Dades Gorges, a camel trek into the dunes, and a night under the stars at a shared desert camp.

cards.title: 5-Day Marrakech, Atlas & Sahara Adventure
cards.blurb: Pair Marrakech's medina with Berber valleys, Ait Benhaddou, Todra Gorge and a slower Sahara camp experience.

cards.title: 6-Day Marrakech, Sahara & Fes Tour
cards.blurb: Ait Benhaddou, the Dades Gorges and a Merzouga desert camp, then two nights and guided sightseeing in Fes.

cards.title: 8-Day Morocco Desert & Atlantic Coast
cards.blurb: Combine the Sahara, Marrakech and the laid-back Atlantic port of Essaouira in one balanced small-group journey.

cards.title: 3-Day Atlas Mountains & Agafay Escape
cards.blurb: Get beyond the city with mountain villages, a guided valley walk and a sunset dinner in the Agafay stone desert.

cards.title: 10-Day Morocco Grand Circuit
cards.blurb: See Morocco's essential cities, mountain passes, desert dunes and coast without rushing every stop.

cards.title: 4-Day Fes, Chefchaouen & Volubilis
cards.blurb: Slow travel through the Fes medina, Roman Volubilis and the blue mountain town of Chefchaouen.

cards.title: 5-Day Shared Marrakech Adventure Tour
cards.blurb: Ourika Valley, the Agafay Desert (camel ride & ATV), and Ouzoud Waterfalls — daily excursions from one hostel, no repacking.

cards.title: 8-Day Marrakech Adventure & Sahara Desert Tour
cards.blurb: Ourika, Agafay and Ouzoud excursions plus a 3-day Sahara loop via Dades Gorges and Merzouga — bundled at a lower price than booking both separately.

cards.title: 7-Day Morocco Highlights Group Tour
cards.blurb: Marrakech, the High Atlas, Sahara dunes, Fes medina, and the blue lanes of Chefchaouen — Morocco's greatest hits in one loop.

cards.title: 8-Day Marrakech, Sahara, Fes & Chefchaouen Tour
cards.blurb: The Sahara-to-Fes route with a luxury Merzouga desert camp, plus round-trip day excursions to Chefchaouen and the Middle Atlas/Ifrane from Fes.

cards.title: More routes joining the calendar
cards.blurb: New shared departures from Fes, Agadir, and Tangier are on the way. Get in touch and we'll let you know when they open.
